messages:
maria: Canary alert — seeing ~0.6% malformed JSON outputs from tool-calls after int8 quant rollout to canary. samples attached. :thinking:

raj: can you paste a tiny failing example?

maria: sure, minimal payload from logs: ```{
  \"tool\": \"db_upsert\",
  \"args\": [{\"id\": \"123\", \"payload\": \"...\"}]
``` then the model output ends with: ```... \"metadata\": {\"user\": \"x\" }``` (truncated, no closing ])}

anya: that looks like token truncation / early stop. what seq_len / max_new_tokens are you using? and stop tokens?

maria: seq_len cap 512, max_new_tokens 256, temperature 0.0, model variant rwd-7b-q8a (int8). no custom stop. requests with long context (>=480) spike.

dave: did we enable KV-prefix caching? that can shift effective tokens and sometimes KVs push generation to stop early.

maria: yes KV prefix caching enabled. also noticed higher parse failures when payloads include long embedded JSON in user messages.

raj: two quick mitigations: 1) gated retry that bumps max_new_tokens +64 and top_p=0.95, 1 retry only; 2) pre-parse "repair" pass: if trailing bracket missing, attempt small heuristics (append `]}` or try to extract last complete JSON object).

anya: prefer deterministic fixes first: extend max_new_tokens on canary, and add a parse-health metric to detect truncation pattern (e.g., endswith not in ["}\"] or unbalanced brackets). Only run heuristic repairs as a fallback and record that.

ci-bot: canary update: rwd-7b-q8a int8 deployed to 20% traffic at 2026-09-12T03:12:10Z.

maria: I ran a quick eval of 5k inferences from canary: heatmap by input length -> parse_fail_rate: 0-320: 0.03%, 321-480: 0.25%, 481-512: 1.8%. attaching short CSV to S3.

raj: ok let's gate the rollout: keep at 20% but disable for requests with input_length>420 until we tune. also track avg_tokens_produced and parse_fail_rate per model-version.

anya: also instrument function-call boundaries: log where model emitted the first function marker (e.g., `\"name\":`) vs user content end — helps detect if model started hallucinating partial JSON.

maria: test plan — I'll spin a focused canary with these changes: (a) +max_new_tokens 64, (b) gated rule to skip int8 for inputs >420, (c) pre-parse repair with single-regex append fallback and metric flagging. Will dump 1k failing cases to S3 and open an eval PR.

dave: :thumbsup: add an alert when parse_fail_rate > 0.5% in 15m for any rollout bucket.

raj: and add a lightweight post-parse validator that runs a strict JSON schema check against the declared tool schema — if fails, route to fallback model-variant (rwd-7b-fp16) automatically.

maria: will do. I'll post the PR with config and the small python repair snippet I'm using. thanks all.
